title: Momondo Flight Scraper Input
description: Search and scrape flight results from Momondo across multiple search modes.

tripType.title: Trip Type
tripType.description: Search mode: 'one-way' for single leg, 'round-trip' for outbound + return, 'multi-city' for multiple stops, 'flexible' for date range search (±N days).

origin.title: Departure Airport
origin.description: 3-letter IATA airport code of the departure airport (e.g., JFK, LHR, CDG).

destination.title: Arrival Airport
destination.description: 3-letter IATA airport code of the destination airport (e.g., LHR, BKK, NRT).

departureDate.title: Departure Date
departureDate.description: Departure date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be today or in the future.

returnDate.title: Return Date
returnDate.description: Return date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Required when Trip Type is 'round-trip'; ignored for other modes.

departureDateFlexDays.title: Flexible Date Range (days)
departureDateFlexDays.description: Number of days around the departure date to search (e.g., 3 = ±3 days). Used only when Trip Type is 'flexible'.

legs.title: Multi-City Legs
legs.description: Array of flight legs for multi-city trips. Each leg: {origin: string (IATA), destination: string (IATA), departureDate: string (YYYY-MM-DD)}. Minimum 2 legs required. Used only when Trip Type is 'multi-city'.

infants.title: Infants
infants.description: Number of infant passengers (under 2 years, lap-held).

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for returned prices (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

maxStops.title: Maximum Stops
maxStops.description: Maximum number of stops. 0 = nonstop only, 1 = max 1 stop, etc. Leave empty for no restriction.

maxResults.title: Max Results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of flight results to return across all pages.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy configuration. By default the actor runs without proxy (direct datacenter requests work on Momondo as of v1). Only configure this if you encounter HTTP 401/429/403 errors.
